title: openai-compat: passthrough seed/determinism flags + metadata for Responses API (streaming & tools compatibility)
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Bring Redwood's OpenAI-compat Responses surface up-to-date with newer Responses API features: allow callers to pass seed/determinism flags through the compat layer, ensure arbitrary metadata fields in Responses.payload are preserved, and fix streaming/tool-calling edge cases introduced by the Responses variants. This PR implements a compatibility shim that: (1) accepts and forwards seed and deterministic flags from openai-style requests to the runtime's sampling layer when the target model supports deterministic seeds; (2) preserves and round-trips arbitrary metadata attached to Responses entries (payload.metadata and per-choice metadata) instead of flattening/losing those keys; (3) stabilizes streaming by ensuring that metadata and function/tool-calls are emitted in the correct SSE order and that mid-stream metadata updates don't break client parsers; (4) adds tests and a docs update for the compat behavior. Changes are limited to the openai_compat adapter, runtime streaming handler fixes, SDK small surface updates (Python), and docs. Backwards compatible by default: existing clients see the same behaviour unless they explicitly pass "seed"/"deterministic" flags; in which case the request is translated and validated. Includes safety checks: unsupported model + deterministic flag results in 400 with actionable error and guidance. See commits and review notes for implementation details and test coverage.
